parent_study.reason_for_new_study: Study 2 observed a positive challenger DR-minus-BTS interval but failed the frozen overlap gate. Any redesign or new empirical test must therefore be prospectively specified as a new study.

research_goal: Test whether the conservative OPE workflow and promotion gate replicate on an OBD campaign not used for Study 2, without selecting the replication source using click outcomes or OPE results.

excluded_campaigns.all: Used for Study 1 and Study 2 training/evaluation and therefore not an independent campaign-level replication source.

source_selection_audit.archive: the exact official OBD archive locked by obd_source_lock.json
allowed_fields: propensity_score values only for support/range validation

requirements: both BTS and Random campaign files exist uniquely in the locked archive
BTS and Random item-context catalogs are identical within the campaign
logged actions are non-empty subsets of the campaign catalog for both policies
raw positions are exactly 1, 2, 3 for both policies
propensity_score is present and lies in (0, 1]
BTS and Random timestamp ranges overlap
qualification_rule.selection: Among qualifying candidate campaigns, choose the campaign with the largest Random-policy row_count. If tied, choose the lexicographically smaller campaign name.
qualification_rule.failure: If no candidate campaign qualifies, Study 3 stops before any click outcome is parsed.

post_selection_rule: After the selected campaign is frozen from value-free source metadata, a separate prospective Study 3 design must freeze its temporal split, reward model, target policies, OPE estimators, bootstrap, and promotion rule before any selected-campaign click outcome is parsed.
no_post_outcome_tuning: Study 2 results may motivate independent replication, but may not be used to soften the Study 2 challenger, overlap threshold, estimator choice, or confidence rule within Study 3 after selected-campaign outcomes are observed.
